title: [Renseikai] Learner App – Submit Attendance – Two students on one device – Each response belongs to the selected student
description: AC 04.2 — State isolation — Switching between two students on one device saves each response to that student’s own session in the same lesson.
preconditions:
- Upcoming published lesson APP-212 is eligible for Student attendance submission.
- Student A and Student B are enrolled in APP-212.
- Both attendance responses are blank.
- The same device can switch between Student A and Student B accounts.
steps_actions:
1. "Student A signs in on the shared device, selects Attended Remotely for APP-212, and submits."
2. "Student B signs in on the same device, selects Attend for APP-212, and submits."
3. "HQ or CM Staff opens the Student Session records for both students in SF and BO."
steps_result:
1. "APP-212 saves Attended Remotely for Student A."
2. "APP-212 saves Attend for Student B."
3. "Student A has Attendance Response Attended Remotely and Status Remote; Student B has Attendance Response and Status Attend."
steps_data:
1. "Student A; response=Attended Remotely"
2. "Student B; response=Attend"
3. "same lesson=APP-212; students=Student A,Student B"
